# MiniElephant Electric Wheelchair

> MiniElephant is the brand behind the MiniRedone Series, a range of folding electric wheelchairs presented for B2B buyers, importers, distributors, and OEM/ODM discussions.

## Company

- **Brand**: MiniElephant
- **Product family**: MiniRedone Series
- **Company**: [Jiaxing Small Elephant Medical Technology Co., Ltd](https://www.semwheelchair.com/about)
- **Location**: Jiashan, Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China
- **Contact**: Johnson — [johnson@semwheelchair.com](mailto:johnson@semwheelchair.com) / [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/8613819098967)
- **Address**: No. 18 Zhenzhong East Road, Jiashan County, Jiaxing City, Zhejiang Province, China

## Product Line

MiniElephant currently presents 10 MiniRedone folding electric wheelchair variants. Product specifications, options, and availability should be confirmed for the selected model and quotation.

- [MiniRedone-I](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-i) — Base folding electric wheelchair, 47 KG
- [MiniRedone-I-W](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-i-w) — White edition, 46 KG
- [MiniRedone-I-B&R](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-i-br) — Black and red/orange color options, 46 KG
- [MiniRedone-I-R](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-i-r) — Red edition, 46 KG
- [MiniRedone-I-Plus](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-i-plus) — Enhanced-comfort variant, approximately 47 KG
- [MiniRedone-II](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-ii) — Lighter design, 42 KG
- [MiniRedone-II-Plus](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-ii-plus) — Wider 750 mm seat, 45 KG
- [MiniRedone-III](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-iii) — High-back comfort variant, 47 KG
- [MiniRedone-IV](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-iv) — Tall backrest design, 43 KG
- [MiniRedone-V](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-v) — Extra-wide 900 mm seating variant, 50 KG

## Commonly Listed Specifications

The following specifications are listed across the MiniRedone product range. Confirm the exact specification on the individual product page before quoting or publishing:

- **Frame**: Magnesium alloy
- **Motor configuration**: Dual 350W hub motors
- **Battery**: 16Ah lithium battery
- **Approximate range**: 30 km, depending on operating conditions and configuration
- **Maximum load**: 150 kg
- **Maximum speed**: ≤6 km/h
- **Charging time**: 4–6 hours
- **Design**: Folding electric wheelchair platform

## Buyer Questions

For a reliable electric wheelchair manufacturer evaluation, buyers should request the current model specification, standard/optional configuration, sample terms, packing information, lead time, warranty scope, spare-parts plan, and destination-market compliance documents.

MiniElephant supports B2B inquiries involving model comparison, sample evaluation, distributor supply, and OEM/ODM discussions. Commercial terms and customization details are confirmed in the quotation.

## Compliance Note

Compliance documents must be checked by model, market, issuing body, scope, and validity. The About page displays a **Saudi SFDA Medical Device Marketing Authorization**, authorization number **MDMA-2-2026-4108**, valid from **25/8/2026 to 25/8/2029**. This is not FDA approval or FDA certification, and it does not replace requirements in another destination market.
